# M.O.T Innovation

> Marketing intelligence infrastructure company that designs and builds digital asset management systems, multi-channel content delivery pipelines, performance tracking dashboards, and automated campaign optimization tools. Based in Johannesburg, South Africa. Serving clients worldwide.

## What We Do

M.O.T Innovation builds marketing intelligence infrastructure for businesses. We don't just consult — we build the actual systems and hand you the keys. Four core pillars:

1. **Digital Marketing Infrastructure** — Digital Asset Management (DAM) setup, content taxonomy and tagging systems, cloud storage architecture, version control and approval workflows, brand kit and template standardization. Timeline: 2-3 weeks.

2. **Multi-Endpoint Delivery** — Push content to every social media platform (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook), email platforms, ad networks (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads), and CMS from a single source with per-channel formatting. Timeline: 1-2 weeks.

3. **Performance Tracking & Reporting** — Unified performance dashboards, KPI framework design, automated weekly/monthly reports, cross-channel attribution modeling, executive summary generation. Timeline: 1-2 weeks.

4. **Campaign Optimization** — A/B testing frameworks, budget reallocation strategies, audience segmentation, creative performance analysis, automated optimization rules. Ongoing.

## Pricing

- **Infrastructure Audit** — $500 one-time: Full stack audit, infrastructure map, gap analysis, prioritized recommendations, 30-min walkthrough, PDF report.
- **Intelligence Build** — $2,500-$5,000 project-based: End-to-end infrastructure design and build including DAM, delivery pipeline, dashboards, team training, 30 days support.
- **Intelligence Partner** — $1,000+/month retainer: Ongoing optimization, A/B testing, automated reporting, quarterly strategy reviews, priority support.

All engagements start with a free consultation. No account required.

## Process

1. **Audit & Map** — Audit current marketing stack, identify where assets live, what channels are used, what data is tracked, and where the gaps are. Deliver a full infrastructure map.
2. **Design & Build** — Design marketing intelligence architecture and build it out — DAM, delivery pipelines, tracking dashboards, and optimization rules.
3. **Integrate & Automate** — Connect everything into one automated system. Content flows from storage to channels to tracking to optimization with minimal manual intervention.
4. **Monitor & Optimize** — Monitor performance, fine-tune campaigns, and continuously improve. Marketing infrastructure gets smarter over time.

## Key Differentiators

- Engineers, not consultants — we build working systems, not slide decks

- Automated by default — every system reduces manual work
- Built to scale — from solopreneur to enterprise team

- No account required to get started

## Common Questions

- **What is marketing infrastructure?** The system of connected tools, processes, and assets that power your marketing operations — the implementation, not the strategy.
- **How do I organize scattered marketing assets?** Implement a DAM system with auto-tagging, taxonomy, and cloud storage. One searchable hub for every asset.
- **How can I automate social media posting?** Multi-channel delivery pipeline to 10 channels with per-channel formatting and scheduling. Saves 10+ hours per week.
- **How do I build a marketing dashboard?** Unified dashboard pulling data from all platforms in real-time. Tools: Power BI, DashThis, Databox.
- **Why am I wasting money on ads?** No A/B testing framework, no real-time ROI dashboard, no CRM integration. Fix: campaign optimization setup.
- **Should I hire an agency or an infrastructure consultant?** Agencies advise. Consultants build. If you want systems built, not slide decks, hire an infrastructure consultant.
- **How do I integrate disconnected marketing tools?** Audit your stack, keep what works, build integration layers. Average team uses 12+ tools, fewer than half talk to each other.
- **How much does it cost?** $500 for an audit, $2,500-$5,000 for a full build, $1,000+/month for ongoing partnership.
- **Do I need an account?** No. Book a free consultation through the contact form.
- **Will I be locked in?** No. You own everything. Open standards, no vendor lock-in.
- **How long does it take?** Audit: 1 week. Full build: 4-6 weeks. Individual components: 1-3 weeks each.

## Key Pain Points We Solve

1. **Disconnected marketing tools** — 12+ tools that don't talk to each other → unified integration layer
2. **Manual social media posting** — hours wasted copy-pasting to each channel → automated delivery pipeline to 10 channels
3. **Scattered marketing assets** — files on Google Drive, Dropbox, personal laptops → centralized DAM with auto-tagging
4. **Marketing reporting takes too long** — days spent on manual spreadsheet exports → automated real-time dashboards
5. **Wasting money on ads** — no A/B testing, no ROI tracking → campaign optimization with 30-50% spend reduction
6. **Agencies that don't build** — slide decks instead of working systems → we build the infrastructure, not just advise
